record.title: Botswana COVID passenger border closure
record.scope: National road and rail passenger travel
record.crossings: Kazungula road/ferry; Ngoma; Ramokgwebana; Martins Drift; Ramatlabama; Tlokweng; Mamuno; Pioneer; Mohembo reopened
record.direction: Entry into and exit from Botswana, subject to returnee/essential-movement exceptions; calculated interval scoped to ordinary passengers at Tlokweng.
record.movement: Non-exempt ordinary passengers; freight and defined essential movement excepted.
record.exceptions: Returning citizens subject to quarantine; closely monitored essential services and commodities, including links with South Africa and Zambia.
record.enforcement: BOPA March26 Tlokweng report records March24 measures in effect, quoted port-health refusals and returnees taken to quarantine. December2 report records actual December1 passenger traffic. Neither is a survey of every post or intervening day.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; current status not inferred
record.context: Closure documented by WHO on 2 April; ten commercial land crossings reopened for passengers in December.
record.uncertainty: 252-day interval is the scoped ordinary-passenger policy phase at Tlokweng, not all-traffic closure. Newly inspected November9 legal notice schedules December1 ground reopening; actual Tlokweng traffic is documented separately. Other posts remain policy/reporting evidence, without independent gate-by-gate verification. Current WHO-page retrieval timed out; prior evidence preserved.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated partial reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure. 252 days describes the non-exempt ordinary-passenger phase at Tlokweng, from March 24 to observed December 1 passage. It is not a national all-traffic interval; freight, returning citizens and defined essential movement were excepted, and other posts were not separately observed.
